rows.jyutping: jung6 lai4 man6 man6 tai4 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this as the everyday Cantonese way to describe a word, phrase, or form that asks a question; it is the all-purpose choice.

example.english: “Who” is an interrogative word used specifically to ask about a person.
example.traditional: 「邊個」係用嚟問問題嘅詞，專門用嚟問人。
example.jyutping: bin1 go3 hai6 jung6 lei4 man6 man6 tai4 ge3 ci4 zyun1 mun4 jung6 lei4 man6 jan2

rows.note: Use this technical label when discussing the interrogative form of a sentence or expression, especially in written or language-learning contexts.

example.english: When analyzing grammar, first distinguish whether the sentence is interrogative or declarative.
example.traditional: 做語法分析嗰陣，要先分清楚句子係疑問式定陳述式。
